content:
{'index': 0, 'translation': 'Apple TV has uploaded the full Hall H panels from its 2026 San Diego Comic-Con (SDCC) debut, including sessions for "Matchbox The Movie," "Widow\'s Bay," "Dark Matter," "Mayday" and "Silo." You can watch them below.'}

{'index': 1, 'translation': 'You can watch all five panels below'}

{'index': 2, 'translation': 'On Saturday (July 25), Apple made its Hall H debut at San Diego Comic-Con, hosting panels for "Matchbox The Movie," "Widow\'s Bay," "Dark Matter," "Mayday" and "Silo."'}

{'index': 3, 'translation': 'Now Apple has posted the full recordings of all the panels on its YouTube channel — you can watch them below.'}

{'index': 4, 'translation': 'The "Mayday" panel featured the action comedy\'s co-writer, producer and director; the film stars Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh.'}

{'index': 5, 'translation': '"Mayday" tells the story of a U.S. Navy pilot shot down behind enemy lines during the Cold War who forges an unlikely alliance with an eccentric former KGB agent. The film premieres on Apple TV on September 4.'}

{'index': 6, 'translation': 'The "Silo" panel brought together showrunner, creator and executive producer Graham Yost, executive producer and star Rebecca Ferguson, and cast members Common, Ashley Zukerman, Jessica Henwick, Alexandria Riley and Tim Robbins.'}

{'index': 7, 'translation': 'The panel discussed the currently airing third season and what Apple TV subscribers can look forward to in the fourth and final season.'}

{'index': 8, 'translation': 'The "Matchbox The Movie" panel featured guests John Cena, Jessica Biel, Sam Richardson, Teyonah Parris and Arturo Castro.'}

{'index': 9, 'translation': 'The cast discussed the upcoming film, which Apple describes as "an action-packed, globe-trotting adventure about a group of lifelong friends whose lives are upended when a CIA undercover agent named Sean (John Cena) — their long-missing former leader — returns to their small town and unknowingly drags them into a high-stakes international chase to save the world."'}

{'index': 10, 'translation': '"Matchbox The Movie" premieres on Apple TV on October 9.'}

{'index': 11, 'translation': 'The "Dark Matter" panel featured stars Joel Edgerton, Jennifer Connelly, Alice Braga and Dayo Okeniyi, as well as series creator, writer and executive producer Blake Crouch, co-writer and executive producer Jacquelyn Ben-Zekry, and executive producer Matt Tolmach.'}

{'index': 12, 'translation': "The panel looked back on the show's first season and offered an early preview of what season two will bring. Season two premieres August 28."}

{'index': 13, 'translation': 'Finally, the highly anticipated "Widow\'s Bay" panel featured previously unannounced guests: showrunner Katie Dippold, director and executive producer Hiro Murai, and cast members Stephen Root, Dale Dickey, Jeff Hiller, K Callan, Kevin Carroll and Kingston Rumi Southwick.'}

{'index': 14, 'translation': "Matthew Rhys also made a surprise appearance, joining the cast and creative team to celebrate the show's breakout success and its 19 Emmy nominations."}

{'index': 15, 'translation': 'Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or it can be bundled through Apple One. The service offers a lineup of hit shows and films including "Severance," "The Studio," "The Morning Show," "Shrinking" and "Silo."'}
